blurb: Guests rent private pontoons with a professional captain, fuel, safety gear, shaded seating, and Bluetooth sound included. Two boats are available: the Berkshire for up to 12 guests with a three-hour minimum, and the Sun Tracker for up to 11 guests with a two-hour minimum. Swimming and floating are allowed when the captain determines conditions are safe; towing and tubing are not permitted.
extraNote: Payment Policy A deposit is required to reserve your charter. · Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy If you need to cancel your reservation, the following refund policy applies based on when we receive your cancellation request: 8 or more days before your charter: 100% of your deposit will be refunded. · 5–7 days before your charter: 50% of your deposit will be refunded. · 3–4 days before your charter: 25% of your deposit will be refunded. · Less than 3 days before your charter: Your deposit is non-refundable. · If you cancel less than 3 days before your scheduled charter, we will gladly apply 100% of your paid deposit toward one rescheduled charter during the current boating season. · Guests
